Certainly lived up to its high ratings
Mar 2026 • Couples
Fantastic food and service. We chose this restaurant due to its high ratings and it didn't disappoint. There was a lovely buzz with lots of local families enjoying their meal. We were welcomed and the menu shared with us. Robert approached us a kindly took us through the menu options. He was so knowledgeable and great company too explaining about the family restaurant. We chose our food and it was truly amazing. I liked that they checked we were comfortable with the prices too as we ordered fresh seafood before it was cooked. We will definitely be back and highly recommend this restaurant who openly welcomed English speakers and helped us make our choices.
